headline: Euro Area Deposit Yields Rise While Cyprus Saver Rates Lag Behind
summary: Eurozone bank deposit rates climbed, but savers in Cyprus continue to receive among the lowest returns in the currency union while loan borrowing costs align with broader European levels.
why: Deposit beta divergence across the euro area affects bank net interest margins and regional capital allocation.

impacts.name: Cyprus Banking Sector
impacts.why: Lenders maintain wider net interest margins by lagging eurozone-wide deposit rate increases.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
